instruction: Set the phone with shiny black back on the L-shaped smooth brown phonestand.

source.instruction: Set the phone with shiny black back on the L-shaped smooth brown phonestand.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the phone, which was at x = -18 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient left gripper pointing down, match phone angle with yaw +30 deg, and move above phone to (-18.5, -12.5, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+11, +6, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +19 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-19, -13, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper towards the phone to z = 83.5 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -13, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower further to grasp height z = 78 cm and fine-tune orientation.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -13, 78) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close left gripper to grasp the phone firmly.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -13, 78) opening 0.82; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift phone to z = 97.5 cm and reorient it upright for placing into the stand.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +19) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -12, 97) opening 0.84; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move phone horizontally towards the phone stand at (-6.5, 5, 97).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+11, +17, +0) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, 4, 97) opening 0.82; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move phone forward and down into the stand slot, then release gripper to complete task.
